name: Relight
summary: Relights a photo: golden hour, neon, studio softbox or any light you describe, keeping the scene intact.

source.notes: Unchanged official template (Qwen Image Edit 2509 fp8 + Relight LoRA + 4-step Lightning LoRA). The Relight trigger is prepended by the workflow.

inputs.label: Light
inputs.default: golden hour sunlight through a low window, warm color temperature, long soft shadows

options.value: golden hour sunlight through a low window, warm color temperature, long soft shadows
options.label: Golden hour

options.value: twilight blue-hour light with warm practical lamps, soft light and blurred shadows
options.label: Blue hour

options.value: neon night lighting, magenta and cyan rim light, dark moody background
options.label: Neon night

options.value: soft studio light from a large softbox on the left, gentle fill, clean shadows
options.label: Studio softbox

options.value: dramatic chiaroscuro, a single hard key light from the side, deep shadows
options.label: Dramatic key light

options.value: overcast daylight, soft and even, no hard shadows
options.label: Overcast

options.value: warm candlelight, flickering amber glow, deep shadows
options.label: Candlelight

inputs.label: Anything else about the light (optional)
inputs.help: e.g. light coming from the right, a red glow from a sign
